Out of 9 applications from 35-44 year-old non-Hispanic Black or African American females in the dataset, 7 were approved (Loan originated), resulting in a 77.8% approval rate. The 2 denied applications had high debt-to-income ratios of 48 and 50%-60%, indicating that the denials were based on standard financial risk factors rather than discriminatory practices.
